subject: B1 V3 components that share information dimensions

redundant_pairs_or_groups.evidence: Phase 12A Class III for Prefilter_J alone. Setting either to BIG individually produces zero new candidates because the other still fires.
Both parameters defined; under default vol_shrink_mode='v1' only vol_vs_wave_peak_max is consumed.
Phase 11 pairwise redundancy matrix: avg int_PF deviation -11.79 pp across windows. Removing either alone gives different surface effects, but both function as 'candidate-set contraction' proxies.
Phase 14A taxonomy: all five express MA-shape; ma_structure_bull is the composite. None active in default ranking (all G2 q_* off).

Both gate the volume profile of the wave, with different sub-conditions. Phase 14B: E alone has ΔPF -0.37; wave_qualified is the dominant generator. The two overlap but are not identical (Phase 14B kept E as a separate concentrator).
All four use white_line / yellow_line. They are not redundant in role (filter vs ranking vs exit), but they all derive from the same two indicator lines.

interaction_redundancy_examples.evidence: Phase 12C grouped as G_double_cap; Phase 14B group avg ΔJac +0.002, both predicates fire on disjoint candidate sets but neither fires under defaults.

non_redundant_pairs_explicitly_confirmed.evidence: Phase 11 verified Jaccard 1.000 between t_plus_3 alone and t_plus_3+anything-entry-side because t_plus_3 does not change candidate selection.

summary.key_finding: Several pairs share information dimensions but mostly through default-config mode-dispatch (vol modes), upstream-shadowing (prefilter vs B1), or proxy filtering (j_max vs pe_max). True alpha redundancy (e.g. j_max/pe_max) was identified only via Phase 11 interaction test, not by feature-name overlap.
